title: FVG entry model — discount only
content: Fair Value Gap entries are highest-quality when price is in discount (below 50% equilibrium) for longs. Require a liquidity sweep and displacement (CHoCH/BOS) before the gap. Invalidate if price closes through the gap origin. Expectation is reaction, not certainty.

title: Liquidity sweep + MSS reversal framework
content: Classic ICT reversal: sweep of prior-day or session liquidity, then market structure shift on the lower timeframe, then entry on the retest of the displacement leg (FVG/OB). Skip if no sweep occurred — chasing displacement without swept liquidity underperforms. Always define invalidation before entry.
